messages:
carmen: spotted an encrypted blob inside a partner onboarding tarball in GCS: gs://partner-feed/onboards/2026-03-21/package.tgz -> path inside: var/data/wrapped_token.bin. will not extract on my laptop; copying to quarantine.

vik: can you paste the first line of the header (redacted) and the object metadata? need to know which KMS key was used. also list who has access to that bucket prefix.

carmen: header (safe-redacted): `gcp-kms://projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/onboard-kr/cryptoKeys/onboard-wrap#v1` . ACLs: group:partner-uploaders (write), infra-runner (read), ci-bots (read).

nadeem: auto-created INC-2026-110. sec-bot flagged as KMS-wrapped artifact. initial severity P2. checklist: quarantine, audit logs, RBAC short block, forensic snapshot.

sec-bot: [AUTO] rule=kms_wrapped_artifact_detected; score=0.86; recommendation=quarantine+audit+key-version

audrey: we need CloudAudit/CloudTrail entries for any Decrypt calls on that key and object GETs for the prefix. Carmen, please export access logs for the last 45 days and attach checksums.

carmen: quarantine copy done: gs://sec-quarantine/6331234567-package.tgz. sha256=7e1f2a... saved to INC-2026-110. not unpacking outside secure project.

vik: quick audit: running `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.resourceName:"projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/onboard-kr/cryptoKeys/onboard-wrap"' --limit=100`. early results show a Decrypt call from `serviceAccount:partner-ci@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com` three days ago. no external IP anomalies.

nadeem: RBAC mitigation proposal: apply a scoped deny for storage.objects.get to the partner-uploaders group on the specific prefix for 6 hours, schedule at 03:00 PT to minimize impact. Audrey please confirm SRE impact.

audrey: SRE: short-lived pipelines may fail during a block. propose window 03:00-04:00 PT and notify devex. approve scoped deny + rollback plan. post policy JSON in INC-2026-110.

vik: key-handling plan: 1) create new key version for onboard-wrap, 2) temporarily remove decrypt binding for non-infra principals on old version, 3) in secure env decrypt quarantined blobs and re-encrypt with new version (rewrap), 4) notify partner to rotate any inner credentials. Carmen/nadeem will coordinate partner comms.

carmen: assigned: carmen -> quarantine + checksum + partner notification draft; vik -> KMS audit + rewrap script; audrey -> SRE window + RBAC apply; nadeem -> incident owner + postmortem. target: mitigations by EOD, sweep in secure env in 24h.

sec-bot: [AUTO] checklist appended to INC-2026-110: export-access-logs, quarantine-copy, create-key-version, remove-old-decrypt-bindings, rewrap-in-secure, partner-notify, postmortem

nadeem: noted. will update the incident ticket as tasks complete. thanks team. :thumbsup:
